content.text: I’m going to make glob patterns a first-class `pg.load` input. A literal filename will still return one `GData`; a pattern will return a `GDataGroup`, including when it matches only one file, so `.interpolate().collect()` remains type-stable. Matches will be ordered naturally (`…_2` before `…_10`) and a zero-match pattern will fail with a targeted message.
